Good evening, Elon Musk more than doubled his fortune over the past 12 months, and he's the top person on the Forbes 400 list of America’s richest people for the fifth straight year. But the ride was anything but smooth for the SpaceX and Tesla chief, who briefly became the world’s first trillionaire after his rocketmaker went public in June. Here's how. Inside the $118 billion fortune of Alice Walton, the only centibillionaire woman in the United States. Thanks for reading!
